title: Jackson Hole Hootenanny @ Dornan's Spur Bar
event_description: Weekly acoustic open mic night featuring folk and traditional music in one of Jackson Hole's most iconic settings. Local and visiting musicians perform two-song sets against the backdrop of the Teton Range.
event_venue_information:
About Dornan's

Dornan's is a family-owned establishment in Grand Teton National Park that has been serving the community since 1922. The venue offers breathtaking views of the Teton Range and sits along the Snake River in Moose Wyoming.

The Hootenanny Tradition

The Jackson Hole Hootenanny began in the 1950s as informal jam sessions under the Snake River bridge led by legendary mountaineer Bill Briggs. After moving to Dornan's in the 1990s the event has become one of Jackson's most beloved musical traditions. During summer months the Hootenanny takes place outdoors at the Chuckwagon stage while winter sessions move to the Silver Dollar Bar at the Wort Hotel downtown.

Other Events at Dornan's

Beyond the Hootenanny Dornan's hosts various community gatherings and offers year-round dining at their Pizza & Pasta Company. The venue features a Trading Post grocery store wine shop and seasonal outdoor Chuckwagon restaurant making it a complete destination within Grand Teton National Park.

title: Bluegrass Tuesdays @ Wort Hotel
event_description: Long-running weekly bluegrass night featuring One Ton Pig a local favorite that has been packing the Silver Dollar Showroom for over 15 years. Free admission with no cover charge and dancing encouraged.
event_venue_information:
About The Wort Hotel

The Wort Hotel is a historic landmark in downtown Jackson Wyoming that has welcomed guests since 1941. The hotel combines classic Western elegance with modern amenities and sits just steps from Town Square.

The Silver Dollar Bar & Showroom

The famous Silver Dollar Bar features 2032 uncirculated 1921 Morgan Silver Dollars inlaid in its serpentine bar top. The adjacent Silver Dollar Showroom serves as Jackson's premier downtown music venue hosting local regional and national acts throughout the year.

Musical Tradition

Bluegrass Tuesdays with One Ton Pig has become a beloved Jackson Hole institution. Named Best Band in the 2025 Best of Jackson Hole contest One Ton Pig draws packed crowds of dancers and music lovers every Tuesday year-round. The venue also hosts live music Thursday Friday and Saturday evenings featuring various genres from country to folk and rock. During winter months the Hootenanny open mic relocates here from Dornan's creating another weekly musical tradition.

title: Open Mic Night @ The Virginian Saloon
event_description: Community-focused open mic and jam session that welcomes musicians poets comedians and performers of all abilities. The night begins with open mic performances and evolves into a collaborative jam session.
event_venue_information:
About The Virginian Saloon

The Virginian Saloon is part of the historic Virginian Lodge which has been a Jackson Hole institution since 1965. This rustic-chic establishment blends authentic Western charm with modern amenities creating an inviting atmosphere for locals and visitors alike.

Entertainment & Atmosphere

The Virginian Saloon offers diverse entertainment throughout the week including open mic nights live music from regional and national bands karaoke sessions and sports viewing on multiple flatscreen TVs. The venue features reclaimed wood stone accents and vintage Western decor creating an authentic cowboy atmosphere.

Community Events

Beyond Tuesday open mics the Virginian hosts Industry Nights on Mondays featuring bingo trivia and rotating themes with late-night happy hour. The saloon has become a hub for the local music community offering a supportive environment for emerging artists and established performers to share their talents with an enthusiastic audience.

title: Open Mic @ Pinky G's Pizzeria
event_description: All-ages open mic night perfect for up-and-coming musicians and performers. The early evening timeslot makes it accessible for younger artists. Three-song limit per performer with guitars available to borrow.
event_venue_information:
About Pinky G's Pizzeria

Pinky G's Pizzeria opened in 2011 and has become Jackson Hole's favorite pizza spot winning the local vote annually. Located in the Pink Garter Plaza just off Town Square the restaurant specializes in hand-tossed New York-style pizza.

Featured on Food Network

Pinky G's has been featured twice on Food Network's Diners Drive-Ins and Dives showcasing their unique pies like the famous Abe Froman. USA Today called it one of the most reasonably priced restaurants in Wyoming's highest rent town making it a popular spot for both locals and visitors.

Music & Community

The pizzeria features a small stage and hosts live music performances from local Jackson Hole musicians in addition to the Monday open mic nights. The all-ages family-friendly atmosphere combined with affordable prices and late-night hours (until midnight on weekends) makes Pinky G's a community gathering place. Performers at the open mic receive a free tallboy or slice of pizza encouraging participation from musicians of all skill levels.

title: Sunday Church @ Stagecoach Bar
event_description: Legendary weekly dance and music night featuring the world-famous Stagecoach Band which has played every Sunday for over 40 years. Known locally as Church this is a Jackson Hole institution with country music and Western swing dancing.
event_venue_information:
About Stagecoach Bar

The Stagecoach Bar has been a Jackson Hole favorite since 1942 making it one of the area's oldest establishments. Located in Wilson Wyoming at the base of Teton Pass the venue is affectionately known as The Coach by locals.

Sunday Church Tradition

The Stagecoach Band has performed more than 2500 Sunday nights over the past 44 years creating one of Wyoming's most enduring musical traditions. Going to church on Sunday evening is local slang for heading to the Stagecoach to dance to live country and Western swing music. The band's performances draw crowds from across the valley filling the large dance floor with couples and solo dancers alike.

Other Entertainment

Thursdays feature Disco Night with a DJ spinning classic hits from the 70s and 80s. The venue offers a full bar with eight beers on tap pool tables darts and during summer a deck with beach volleyball. Friday and Saturday nights often feature one-off shows with touring and regional acts. The Stagecoach Grill serves affordable Mexican food and burgers and the venue includes a full-service liquor store with a drive-up window.

title: Winter Hootenanny @ Wort Hotel
event_description: During winter months the famous Jackson Hole Hootenanny relocates from Dornan's to the historic Silver Dollar Bar. This acoustic open mic welcomes all performers for two-song sets in an intimate downtown setting.
event_venue_information:
About The Wort Hotel

The Wort Hotel is a historic landmark in downtown Jackson Wyoming that has welcomed guests since 1941. The hotel combines classic Western elegance with modern amenities and sits just steps from Town Square.

The Silver Dollar Bar

The famous Silver Dollar Bar features 2032 uncirculated 1921 Morgan Silver Dollars inlaid in its serpentine bar top. First opened in 1950 the bar has been a hotspot for drinking socializing and live music for over 70 years. The bar's Western decor and vintage atmosphere create an authentic Jackson Hole experience.

Hootenanny Winter Home

Since October 2021 the Hootenanny has called the Silver Dollar Bar home during winter months when Dornan's outdoor venue is closed. This partnership allows the nearly 30-year tradition to continue year-round. The intimate indoor setting creates a different but equally special atmosphere for performers and audience members. Meet me at the Wort has been a common refrain in Jackson for decades and the Hootenanny reinforces this gathering place tradition.
